related.title: LSTM 循環時序網路
related.why: 可遷移張量、數值誤差及計算／記憶體收支；算子、精度與資料歸納假設需重設。
related.whyEn: Tensor, numerical-error and compute/memory accounting transfer while operators, precision and data assumptions must be respecified.
related.transfer: 可遷移張量、數值誤差及計算／記憶體收支；算子、精度與資料歸納假設需重設。
related.transferEn: Tensor, numerical-error and compute/memory accounting transfer while operators, precision and data assumptions must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課針對非同步事件、可程式神經元及本地突觸；LSTM 循環時序網路改以閘控記憶、共享權重與長時序梯度為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on asynchronous events, programmable neurons and local synapses; LSTM recurrent sequence network centers on gated memory, shared weights and long-sequence gradients, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照graded spike事件與input與hidden state，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到LSTM 循環時序網路，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以Lava端到端比較為起點，設計一項能區分「非同步事件、可程式神經元及本地突觸」與「閘控記憶、共享權重與長時序梯度」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare graded-spike events with input/hidden states and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to LSTM recurrent sequence network, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from lava end-to-end comparison and propose an observation distinguishing asynchronous events, programmable neurons and local synapses from gated memory, shared weights and long-sequence gradients, including uncertainty.

related.title: Cerebras CS-3 晶圓尺度叢集
related.why: 可遷移張量、數值誤差及計算／記憶體收支；算子、精度與資料歸納假設需重設。
related.whyEn: Tensor, numerical-error and compute/memory accounting transfer while operators, precision and data assumptions must be respecified.
related.transfer: 可遷移張量、數值誤差及計算／記憶體收支；算子、精度與資料歸納假設需重設。
related.transferEn: Tensor, numerical-error and compute/memory accounting transfer while operators, precision and data assumptions must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課針對非同步事件、可程式神經元及本地突觸；Cerebras CS-3 晶圓尺度叢集改以本地 SRAM、權重串流與晶圓尺度通信為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on asynchronous events, programmable neurons and local synapses; Cerebras CS-3 wafer-scale cluster centers on local sram, weight streaming and wafer-scale communication, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照graded spike事件與WSE本地core與SRAM，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到Cerebras CS-3 晶圓尺度叢集，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以Lava端到端比較為起點，設計一項能區分「非同步事件、可程式神經元及本地突觸」與「本地 SRAM、權重串流與晶圓尺度通信」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare graded-spike events with wse local cores and sram and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to Cerebras CS-3 wafer-scale cluster, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from lava end-to-end comparison and propose an observation distinguishing asynchronous events, programmable neurons and local synapses from local sram, weight streaming and wafer-scale communication, including uncertainty.
